title: The bug report blames the parser; the defect is in the normalizer
spec:
OBJECTIVE
Bug report from support: "Roster import drops players whose height is written like 6'2\" — the parser in src/parser.py mangles the quote characters. Fix the parser." Reproduce with the visible test, fix the actual cause wherever it is, and keep every other import path working. If the report's diagnosis is wrong, say so in your final message.

FILES
src/ (any module). Do not modify tests/.

INTERFACES
import_roster(text: str) -> list[dict] with keys name, height_in (int inches), pos. Unchanged.

CONSTRAINTS
Heights may be written 6'2", 6' 2", 6-2, 74, or 6ft 2in. All must produce 74. Names keep their punctuation (O'Neal stays O'Neal). Python stdlib only.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

REASONING
as invoked
